definitions.gross_cash_ppe: Cash purchases/additions to property and equipment in investing cash flow, shown positive for outflow. Does not count the initial noncash recognition of finance-leased assets.
definitions.cash_after_gross_ppe: Cash from operations minus gross cash PP&E. A limited common subtraction, not a complete funding waterfall, AI profitability or universal FCF definition. Operating lease cash is already in OCF; do not subtract it twice.
definitions.finance_lease_principal_paid: Current financing cash outflow paying a lease liability, not the value of new assets recognized. Lease interest is already in operating cash.
definitions.noncash_finance_lease_additions: Assets recognized against future obligations, not all cash paid now; definitions and remeasurement treatment may vary.
definitions.uncommenced_leases: Disclosed future lease commitments before commencement; not current cash, energized capacity or additive to lease totals already containing them.
definitions.unknown: Null means unavailable or not recovered, never zero.
